title: Design review runbook, agenda, and pre-reads — slot coordination
text:
Design review runbook, agenda, and pre-reads — slot coordination

["From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acme.com>\\nTo: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>\\nCc: acme-platform@acme.com\\nDate: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Redwood architecture review — request and potential slots\\n\\nHi Priyom,\\n\\nThanks again for the demo last week — the ACME infra team would like to follow up with a focused architecture deep-dive to validate network, SSO, and MTLS expectations before we move to procurement.\\n\\nHigh-level asks for the session:\\n- Walk through network topology and firewall/NAT requirements (we have a corporate proxy)\\n- Authentication and SSO flows (SAML/OIDC; audit log retention)\\n- Deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and data residency implications\\n- Expected latencies for typical request patterns (50–500 tokens) and scaling behavior\\n\\nWe can do a 60–75 minute session. Proposed slots (PT):\\n- Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:15\\n- Thu Nov 19, 14:00–15:15\\n- Fri Nov 20, 09:30–10:45\\n\\nIf those won't work, happy to take a calendar invite with alternative times. Also: could you share any pre-reads (slides + diagrams) so our SREs can prep questions?\\n\\nThanks,\\nElena\\nElena Martin\\nSr. Platform Architect, Acme Corp\\n\\nAttachments: (none in this message)\\n", 'From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acme.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Design review runbook, agenda, and pre-reads — slot coordination\\n\\nHi Elena — great to hear you want to do a deep-dive. Any of the Thu Nov 19 slots work for us; let’s tentatively hold Thu 11/19 14:00–15:15 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm.\\n\\nI’ve attached a short runbook and an annotated network diagram to help your SREs prep. Draft agenda below (60–75 min):\\n\\n1) 5 min — Introductions and goals (Priyom / Elena)\\n2) 15 min — High-level deployment options & tradeoffs (Laura)\\n3) 20 min — Network & security deep-dive (Jonas)\\n4) 10 min — SSO / audit logging & compliance notes (Rishi)\\n5) 10–20 min — Q&A + follow-ups / next steps (All)\\n\\nPre-reads (short):\\n- redwood-design-runbook-v1.pdf (attached) — 6 pages, includes SLOs, operating assumptions\\n- acme-network-diagram-annotated.png (attached) — proposed placement options and ports\\n- Confluence: ACME Design Runbook (link below) — internal runbook with SSO/retention examples\\n\\nAre there any specific diagrams or test scenarios your team wants us to include in the session? If so, reply here and we’ll update the materials before the meeting.\\n\\nI’ll coordinate internal owners for each agenda item (see internal note below).\\n\\nThanks,\\nPriyom\\nPriyom Das\\nSenior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference\\n\\nAttachments: redwood-design-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 540KB); acme-network-diagram-annotated.png (PNG, 220KB); meeting-agenda.docx (DOCX, 24KB)\\n', 'From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-11-18T11:15:00-08:00\\nSubject: Internal: ACME arch review — who covers what (Thu 11/19 14:00 PT tentative)\\n\\nInternal — quick coordination thread. Tentative external slot Thu 11/19 14:00–15:15 PT. Elena requested network/topology, SSO, and latency expectations. Proposed owners:\\n- Laura: deployment options + cost/latency tradeoffs (15m) — bring the quantization/throughput slide and a short bench table for 50/200/500 token loads\\n- Jonas: network & firewall details (20m) — prepare connectivity matrix, NAT/SNAT recommendations, and overlay diagrams for VPC/private deployments\\n- Rishi: SSO & audit logs (10m) — include retention defaults and where audit exports live for Dedicated/Private\\n- Priyom/Marissa: intros + Q&A moderation and procurement next steps (10–20m)\\n\\nPrep tasks before EOD 11/18:\\n- Laura: attach a 1-slide bench summary (PDF) to the runbook (action: laura)\\n- Jonas: export a higher-res network diagram and highlight required outbound ports (action: jonas)\\n- Rishi: draft a short list of questions we should ask ACME about their logging/KMS requirements (action: rishi)\\n\\nI’ll collate updates and send the final pre-read set by 09:00 PT on 11/19.\\n\\n— Priyom\\n\\n> On Nov 18, 2026, at 11:03 AM, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> > I’ve attached a short runbook and an annotated network diagram to help your SREs prep.\\n', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-11-18T16:42:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Internal: ACME arch review — who covers what (Thu 11/19 14:00 PT tentative)\\n\\nAll — attaching a one-slide micro-benchmark summary and updated runbook PDF (v1.1). I also added a small section under "Latency expectations" with numbers for 50/200/500 token payloads using the Dedicated GPU profile we discussed.\\n\\nFiles uploaded: redwood-design-runbook-v1.1.pdf (attached), bench-summary-50-200-500.pdf (attached)\\n\\nQuick notes:\\n- The bench numbers assume warm KV-cache; cold-starts add ~15–25ms per request in small-sample tests.\\n- For Hosted vs Dedicated, include a callout on tail-latency behavior when autoscaling triggers.\\n\\nWill be online during the session to demo the throughput table if needed.\\n\\n— Laura\\n\\nAttachments: redwood-design-runbook-v1.1.pdf; bench-summary-50-200-500.pdf\\n', 'From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acme.com>\\nTo: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>\\nCc: acme-platform@acme.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-11-19T14:03:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Design review runbook, agenda, and pre-reads — slot coordination\\n\\nThanks — Thu 11/19 14:00 PT works for us, but our lead SRE had a conflict and asked if we could move to 11/19 15:00–16:15 PT instead. Would that be possible?\\n\\nIf so, please send an updated calendar invite and include a brief testing checklist (ports to test, sample request payloads) for our SREs to exercise after the call.\\n\\nElena\\n\\n-----Original Message-----\\nFrom: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>\\nSent: Wed, Nov 18, 2026 11:03 AM\\nTo: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acme.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>\\nSubject: Re: Design review runbook, agenda, and pre-reads — slot coordination\\n\\nI’ll update internal owners and send a final pre-read by 09:00 PT tomorrow.\\n\\nAttachments referenced: redwood-design-runbook-v1.1.pdf, bench-summary-50-200-500.pdf, acme-network-diagram-annotated.png\\n']
